notes: 2025-2026 edition, հայտորոշիչ (the Drive folder also holds a superseded «/old.docx» copy — this key is from the current document). Q1-Q3 are listening items scored against the audio recording linked from the paper. DEFECT (Q4): the source key answers «2-c» while quoting the text of option d — option c is «Ես գիրք կարդացի…», a translation of sentence 1, not of «They played football yesterday». Corrected to 2-d here; note that d is itself past-continuous («էին խաղում») for a past-simple English sentence, so it is the intended answer only by elimination. Q6 item 4's corrected sentence («They should not finish the project before the deadline») is semantically odd but is the modal fix the task asks for. Q7's box holds five words for four gaps — «reported» is the odd one — and two orderings are equally correct.

key.answer: 1) When the rain started, they were playing in the park. 2) When the phone rang, she was reading her favourite book. 3) When the teacher entered the classroom, we were talking about our homework.

A 120-150 word essay on whether modern holidays have become too commercial, stating what the pupil thinks the main purpose of holidays should be (rest, family, shared memories rather than buying gifts) and suggesting one way to make them more meaningful (simple traditions — cooking together, sharing stories, helping others).
key.scoring_notes: Critical thinking — both required points must appear; either side of the argument scores if defended.
